title: Generic test event
description: Represents a real-time event for a transport service

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version as integer greater than 0

eventName.description: A name used to describe the event type being raised

timestamp.description: Event publication time in milliseconds since the UNIX epoch (January 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC)

content.description: The content of the event, usually any of the defined models in the protocol.
